summary.description: Enables identical protein binding activity and intracellularly calcium-gated chloride channel activity. Acts upstream of or within chloride transport. Located in non-motile cilium and plasma membrane. Is active in glutamatergic synapse and presynaptic membrane. Is expressed in dorsal root ganglion; epidermis; medulla oblongata basal plate mantle layer; olfactory epithelium; and spinal cord mantle layer. Orthologous to human ANO2 (anoctamin 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]
ANO2 belongs to a family of calcium-activated chloride channels (CaCCs) (reviewed by Hartzell et al., 2009 [PubMed 19015192]).[supplied by OMIM, Jan 2011]

Enables intracellularly calcium-gated chloride channel activity. Predicted to be involved in chloride transmembrane transport. Predicted to act upstream of or within chloride transport. Predicted to be located in non-motile cilium. Predicted to be active in glutamatergic synapse and presynaptic membrane. Orthologous to human ANO2 (anoctamin 2).
